SelectableTextBlock||||In this mode the agent connects directly to the model endpoint you choose. Fadenstack runs no server in this mode. On your device, the agent marks AI-generated content where this is technically feasible: it writes signed, machine-readable information into document and e-mail properties and keeps a local record. Whether chat text and inserted text also carry an invisible text watermark depends on your endpoint; the agent shows the status for your connection. Server mode can add a text watermark during generation. This mode makes no pictures. Metadata can be lost when content is copied, converted or edited. If you use AI-generated content in your work or publish it, you may have your own disclosure duties, for example under Article 50(4) of the EU AI Act for deep fakes and for texts published to inform the public on matters of public interest. Please do not remove or alter the markings, except for legitimate purposes such as security testing.|
